topics.title: Warhammer 40K Lore Deep Dives: Primarchs, Chaos, and Character-Driven Narratives
topics.what_is_driving_it: Multiple high-velocity shorts on Primarch lore (Lorgar, Horus, Blood Angels ritual, Nurgle mechanics) are consistently hitting 100k+ views/day with strong engagement.
topics.relevance_note: 40k Daily and similar channels dominate this space with short-form lore, but there's a gap for mid-form (5–15 min) cinematic narrative videos that deep-dive into character motivation and faction philosophy rather than surface-level facts.
topics.gap_note: Lore shorts perform well but lack strategic, character-focused storytelling. Account can own 'Why Primarchs Made the Choices They Did' or 'Faction Philosophy' videos—deeper than shorts, more dramatic than wiki dumps.

examples.name: Everything Hallelujah
examples.cinematic_angle: Split the frame: left side shows primer, bare plastic, workspace chaos; right side shows the finished model under studio lighting. Let the 'Hallelujah' swell carry the left-to-right transition. The audio's jubilance becomes genuine when applied to the craft's actual transformative power.

examples.name: Respect
examples.cinematic_angle: Draw each model component directly onto a blank surface or over a base model: sketch the armor plate → real paint appears; sketch the weapon → detailed model materializes. Each line of Aretha's vocal builds the character. Frames painting as manifestation of will, respectable skill, creative control.

examples.name: Someday We Will Dream About Today
examples.cinematic_angle: Use over a completed army showcase or collection documentation. Let the audio's backward-looking sentiment frame the hobby as a lived experience worth preserving, not just a collection of objects. Emphasizes the filmmaker's implied observation that the *process* and *memory* matter as much as the finished piece.

examples.name: Patient Zero
examples.cinematic_angle: Layer over a reveal moment in a terrain-building or conversion sequence — let the accusatory tone suggest a character origin story unfolding in miniature.

trend_scout.insight: Lean into Hobby + trending audio format this week by filming a miniature painting timelapse set to "Everything Hallelujah" to capture momentum in your niche.
